scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Samajik Sahayata Prakalpa - Vulnerable Women
other_conditions: Applicant must be a woman (widow, deserted, unmarried, or any vulnerable woman).
Age must be between 18 and 59 years; if unmarried, age must be 45 years or above.
Family annual income must not exceed ₹1,00,000.
If the family has children aged 6 to 14 years, those children must be enrolled in a school recognized by the Government of Tripura.
Assistance stops upon death of beneficiary, remarriage of a widow, a family member obtaining a government job, or if family income exceeds ₹1,00,000.
benefits_summary: Monthly pension of ₹2,000 transferred directly to the applicant’s bank account.
